owner_brief: Jeung just totally annihilated a G-King group. He walked in, calm and cool, and walked out again, leaving nothing but bodies. Get into our newly claimed turf and <Col: StageText>spray </Col>our colors up!
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses have made a move to expand their territory. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>those emo assholes from <Col: StageText>spraying </Col>up their colors.

owner_brief: The bodies of those G-King scum aren't even cold yet and we're already hearing rumblings of revolt. <Col: StageText>Take control </Col>of this troublesome <Col: StageText>area</Col>. Show these welfare state fucks who's in charge.
dispatch_brief: Blood Roses are intimidating the locals to establish control of their new-found turf. <Col: StageText>Defend </Col>the <Col: StageText>area</Col>. Without their guns I doubt they could intimidate an old lady, never mind a neighborhood.

owner_brief: God, these plebs don't give up. We've got some G-King sympathizers being vocal now. <Col: StageText>Take control </Col>of the <Col: StageText>area</Col>; flash your guns and let them know you're there. They'll get the message.
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses are moving to put down the more vocal members of our community. <Col: StageText>Defend </Col>this <Col: StageText>area </Col>from the Roses. If you manage to take any Roses alive, let me know: I could use the target practice.

owner_brief: Well, well - looks like these crybabies went one step further and called the Enforcers. If it's not the Gs, it's these badge-waving pricks. Don't let them take the block. <Col: StageText>Capture the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses have secured a stranglehold over the people in this block. Show these skeletal goth wannabes that we ain't impressed - <Col: StageText>capture the area</Col> out from under them.

owner_brief: Orders from on high: we gotta take control of a new block. Get in there and show the locals who's in charge. <Col: StageText>Spray </Col>our colors loud and proud.
dispatch_brief: Some G-King dirtbags just ran another gang out of their turf. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the Gs from <Col: StageText>spraying </Col>up their colors and solidifying their position.

owner_brief: Good. The block should know what the G-King colors mean now, but there are still pockets of resistance. <Col: StageText>Take control </Col>of this <Col: StageText>area</col>. Scare the shit out of anyone who ain't a G.
dispatch_brief: The G-Kings are rolling on the locals, trying to establish control. <Col: StageText>Defend </Col>this <Col: StageText>area </Col>and keep the Gs out. We've got enough dumbass haircuts and bad clothing round here as it is.

owner_brief: Looks kinda quiet! But sure as shit, the locals are asking for Enforcer protection right about now... We better consolidate. <Col: StageText>Take control </Col>of this <Col: StageText>area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The G-Kings are moving to put down any resistance in the block. <Col: StageText>Defend </Col>this <Col: StageText>area </Col>from the Criminals and show them what authority really means.

owner_brief: New turf; same old call to the Enforcers... Don't let them take back our territory. <Col: StageText>Capture the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: According to high command, this ain't going so well. At this rate, we'll never get the Gs out! Throw away the textbook on civic-minded Enforcement: <Col: StageText>capture the area</col>.

owner_brief: We've tracked down a couple of major drug dealers. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these <Col: StageText>drug dens </Col>and pick up any substances you find.
dispatch_brief: A vice squad caught dealers with the Glow we smuggled into the city. We don't want anyone tracking the drug back to us. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>the dealer's hideouts.

owner_brief: Good work, we had a tip-off that these dealers were pushing some unusual Class A merchandise. <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>the <Col: StageText>powder </Col>to our <Col: StageText>lab </Col>for analysis.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers have the drugs! If they realize it's Glow, they'll look under every rock in the city till they find the shipment. <Col: StageText>Prevent the delivery </Col>of the drug to the Enforcer's lab.

owner_brief: The powder is Glow, and it's a killer! With those dealers gone, the supplier decided to get out fast - now quick, <Col: StageText>defuse the bombs </Col>on these <Col: StageText>boxes </Col>of Glow before the supplier blows them up!
dispatch_brief: We can't let the Enforcers find the raw Glow, or they'll work out how we've been smuggling it in. We've set explosives to destroy our remaining stock. <Col: StageText>Protect </Col>the <Col: StageText>boxes </Col>until the bombs go off.

owner_brief: Those suppliers didn't move quickly enough - we located the lab equipment they used to refine the Glow. <Col: StageText>Keep </Col>the <Col: StageText>box</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Now the Enforcers know we're importing raw Glow, we're moving the refining lab before the Enforcers can find it. <Col: StageText>Keep </Col>the <Col: StageText>lab equipment </Col>safe from Enforcers <Col: StageText>or take out </Col>the <Col: StageText>investigators</Col>.

owner_brief: We've been after the Four-Wheeled Doggi artist for years. Whoever that seditious mofo is, they just sent out more Gs to destroy the evidence. <Col: StageText>Disarm </Col>the bombs on these <Col: StageText>ticket machines</Col>.

owner_brief: Want a golden Doggi? Our analysts located the treasure by buying over 2,000,000 cans of XSChill. <Col: StageText>Confiscate </Col>the <Col: StageText>suitcase </Col>. God, this stuff tastes like ass...
dispatch_brief: Lucky break! We tortured an exec from the ticket company until they told us where the golden ticket was. <Col: StageText>Keep </Col>the <Col: StageText>suitcase </Col>away from the Enforcers!

owner_brief: A chop shop gang posted a recording of their plans to eliminate a rival garage on Lie-Net. Eva wants you to <Col: StageText>pick up</Col> the <Col: StageText>camcorder</Col> with the unedited footage.

owner_brief: The recording also shows the chop shop gang attaching bombs to two of the rival gang's cars. <Col: StageText>Disarm</Col> these <Col: StageText>bombs</Col> before they hurt any civilians.
dispatch_brief: The recording those 'Forcers captured also shows the bombs we attached to the rival chop shop's cars. <Col: StageText>Prevent</Col> the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>disarming</Col> the bombs.

owner_brief: The chop shop gang is hunting down the rival gang's members at their hangout. Eva thinks you should <Col: StageText>capture the area </Col>.
dispatch_brief: Those Praetorians are a real pain in the ass! <Col: StageText>Capture</Col> this <Col: StageText>area</Col> so we can move our operation.

owner_brief: Chiza wants justice served on a chop shop gang that tried to blackmail her. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>this <Col: StageText>camcorder</Col> - it has a recording of the gang and their stolen cars.
dispatch_brief: You know Chiza? Annoying Prentiss Tiger? We tried to bribe her, and now the bitch is after our chop shop. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>a camcorder with a recording of our operations.

owner_brief: Good work; <Col: StageText>drop off </Col>the <Col: StageText>camcorder </Col>at our tech lab. They'll analyze the footage and find anything we can use for evidence against the chop shop gang.
dispatch_brief: Chiza's got the Tigers running off with camcorder evidence that features our chop shop. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the Enforcers from reaching their <Col: StageText>drop-off </Col>with the camera.

owner_brief: The gang knows we're after them - a parolee let slip we took their camcorder. <Col: StageText>Disarm </Col>the bombs on these <Col: StageText>garage </Col>doors before the gang can blow everything sky-high!
dispatch_brief: Fuck Chiza! I know her squad wants to ransack our chop shop for themselves. If we can't have it, no one can! <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>disarming </Col>the bombs on our garages.

owner_brief: The gang is destroying any stolen cars featured in the recording. <Col: StageText>Disarm </Col>these <Col: StageText>bombs </Col>- or the recording will be useless as evidence. Chiza will personally drive the cars back to our lockup.
dispatch_brief: Now the Tigers are headed for the stolen cars we fixed up. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>disarming </Col>the bombs on our cars. Leave nothing for Chiza and her squad!

owner_brief: Now that chop shop operation is toast, the gang's trying to claim another area and set up again. Chiza thinks you should <Col: StageText>capture the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: It's Chiza's fault we had to target our own chop shops and cars - we'll take our revenge later! Meanwhile, <Col: StageText>capture </Col>this new <Col: StageText>area </Col>so we can start fresh.

owner_brief: A producer working at Moki 808 has been under SPPD investigation for embezzlement. Now he's gone missing. <Col: StageText>Pick up</Col> his <Col: StageText>briefcase</Col> - it could help us locate him.
dispatch_brief: A producer at Moki 808 was under SPPD investigation for embezzlement until we put him six feet under. The Enforcers found his briefcase - <Col: StageText>prevent</Col> them from <Col: StageText>picking it up</Col>.

owner_brief: Hopefully this briefcase can help us find the Moki 808 producer, and clear up some mysteries in the embezzlement case against him. <Col: StageText>Drop off</Col> the briefcase at our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The briefcase contains a ledger proving the producer was embezzling money from Moki 808 with our help. <Col: StageText>Prevent </Col>the briefcase being <Col: StageText>dropped off</Col>, or Enforcers will start looking for accomplices.

owner_brief: The briefcase contained a bail bond receipt for the producer's son, and receipts for the funding of a fake TV show in Korea. <Col: StageText>Search </Col>the producer's <Col: StageText>portacabins</Col> for further evidence.
dispatch_brief: The ledger details meetings we held at the producer's portacabins. <Col: StageText>Prevent</Col> the Enforcers from <Col: StageText>searching</Col> the cabins for further evidence that could connect us with the producer's embezzlement.

owner_brief: The producer's been murdered for his embezzled money. His safe's contents implicate the killers, but they're trying to disrupt the case. Either <Col: StageText>drop off</Col> the safe at our <Col: StageText>lockup.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers have the producer's safe! With that, even Helen Keller could follow the embezzlement paper trail directly to us. <Col: StageText>Capture and drop off</Col> the safe.

owner_brief: Imitation is the sincerest form of flattery, I suppose, but we're drowning in a sea of Blood Rose-style gangs. We need to ensure everyone knows we are the original and best. <Col: StageText>Spray the area </Col>in your own beautiful way.
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses have been spotted in the area carrying spray cans; it's guaranteed they aren't planning to freshen up the playground. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>tagging </Col>the area up.

owner_brief: Elegant. This block is all yours. <Col: StageText>Spray </col>our designs on every spot you can find. But save some paint - you've got more to do.
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses must think this block is their own private canvas. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>spraying</Col> up any more of their crap.

owner_brief: A wonderful sight. That block is a beacon of Blood Rose style. <Col: StageText>Spray </Col>another block and our dominance will be seen by all.
dispatch_brief: I'm going to shake those Blood Roses up and down like a spray can until I hear something rattle inside. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>spraying</Col> their colors here.

owner_brief: Your creative work has attracted some attention - not from the art critics, but from the Enforcers. <Col: StageText>Bomb this area </Col>and they will be too busy to cover up your tags.
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses don't like us covering up their tags, and have thrown a tantrum. <Col: StageText>Stop the Roses </Col>from planting a <Col: StageText>bomb </Col>in this public area.

owner_brief: The city has been getting way too crowded with other crews and Enforcers. We need to be sure everyone remembers that it's the G-Kings who rule San Paro. <Col: StageText>Spray the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The G-Kings have been spotted in the area carrying spray cans. You know what they're up to. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>spraying </Col>the area.

owner_brief: Cool, hit the rest of the block and <Col: StageText>spray our tags </Col>on every spot you can find. G-King b-ling, baby.

owner_brief: Bonita Benjamin saw your work and loved it. She thinks it needs to be more widely seen. <Col: StageText>Spray </Col>another block so everyone knows we totally own this area.
dispatch_brief: It's so cute to see the G-Kings learning to read and write. But I wish they wouldn't practice by <Col: StageText>spray painting </Col>on the walls. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

owner_brief: Let's get some extra publicity for your work. <Col: StageText>Set off a bomb </Col>in this public place to draw in the news crews.
dispatch_brief: The G-Kings have finished tagging the area and are hell-bent on ensuring everyone notices it. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>setting off a bomb </Col>in this public area.

owner_brief: Enforcers have cleaned off a bunch of tags as part of an anti-graffiti drive by Mayor Derren. This fresh canvas is an opportunity for us to take graffiti in a new direction. <Col: StageText>Tag these areas. </Col>

owner_brief: Despite Derren's occasional crackdowns, the people of San Paro know our art well. That can only happen through dedicated tagging. The art in these areas has been cleaned off; <Col: StageText>tag them up </Col>again.
dispatch_brief: There used to be more tags on this city than tattoos on a G-King. We can't let San Paro fall back into that sorry state. <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the graffiti crew from <Col: StageText>tagging </Col>these spots.

owner_brief: The Enforcers are realizing we're not just a bunch of easily intimidated street kids. Show them and show Derren that our artistic expression can't be silenced! <Col: StageText>Tag these spots </Col>up.
dispatch_brief: I don't care how artistic that graffiti crew think these tags are, it's still defacing city property. <Col: StageText>Prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>tagging </Col>these locations.

dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses are currently transporting the stolen vehicle in order to strip it for parts. Man, they're like a swarm of piranhas. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering that car</Col>.

owner_brief: Jeung says he'll need some souped-up parts to give him an advantage in the race. <Col: StageText>Steal, then deliver this car </Col>to our hideout. It has the suspension needed to withstand a nitro boost.
dispatch_brief: The Blood Roses will need more spare parts than they got from that last vehicle. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>stealing the car </Col>and taking a can opener to it at their lockup.

The Blood Roses will need more spare parts than they got from that last vehicle. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>stealing the car </Col>and taking a can opener to it at their lockup.

dispatch_brief: <Col: StageText>Recover the car parts</Col> the Roses stole, and <Col: StageText>keep them</Col> out of their hands. Last thing we need is Jeung attracting more recruits with a souped-up ride...

owner_brief: We've seen your sly grand theft auto skills. Most of the G-Kings just huck a brick through the window. <Col: StageText>Steal</Col> this vehicle to order, windows intact.

owner_brief: Sweet ride. <Col: StageText>Deliver</Col> it to the drop off point we've been given. A friend of Zombie's named Deadbolt will pick it up later. It's for his Auntie - ain't he sweet?
dispatch_brief: The G-Kings are currently transporting a 'stolen to order' vehicle. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering that car</Col>. Don't worry too much about its condition, as long as those dirty skid marks don't get to keep it.

The list of cars to be stolen by the G-Kings seems accurate. All the owners've been told to move their cars, except for one we can't reach. <Col: StageText>Stop the G-Kings </Col>from <Col: StageText>stealing that car</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Pick up the car parts</Col> we've stolen and <Col: StageText>keep them</Col> out of the hands of our opponents. If Deadbolt doesn't get what he wants, he tends to go looking for the people who let him down...
dispatch_brief: <Col: StageText>Recover the car parts</Col> the G-Kings stole, and <Col: StageText>keep them</Col> out of their hands. Last thing we need is those punks driving souped-up rides...

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Spray</Col> up the <Col: StageText>area</Col> to discourage anyone else from having rebellious thoughts.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Spray</col> our tags up to send a clear message to anyone else thinking of dissing the G-Kings.
dispatch_brief: Now the G-Kings are tagging up the neighborhood, laughing at your security detail. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>spraying </col>up their crap. That'll wipe the smile off their faces!

dispatch_brief: Lou Konchoda's gang just stole a van, and we suspect they are going to break into a couple of stores. If they follow their usual MO, you'll have to <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>stealing the store safes</Col>.

owner_brief: Nice, the guys are gonna love having some cash to improve the place - I've got a mini-fridge all picked out for our beer. <Col: StageText>Drop the safe </Col>at the hideout; we've got a safe-cracker there who can open it.
dispatch_brief: Too late! The gang made off with some safes. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the safes </Col>to their hideout. Lou Konchoda can crack 'em like walnuts if he gets his hands on them.

owner_brief: Get rid of those hot wheels - don't want that thing tracked back to us. <Col: StageText>Drop the van off.</Col> Then you can pick up the gold lamé wallpaper we ordered...
dispatch_brief: After dropping off those stolen safes, Lou Konchoda's gang is trying to ditch the vehicle used in the robbery so it can't be combed for evidence. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>abandoning the van</Col>.

owner_brief: Shit, you were spotted dumping the van. Create a distraction and <Col: StageText>burn these vehicles</Col>. Don't take long - Pimp My Crib is on in twenty minutes...
dispatch_brief: Lou's gang ditched their van near the freeway construction and are trying to burn other vehicles to disrupt our attempts to capture them. <Col: StageText>Stop the gang </Col>from <Col: StageText>burning the vehicles</Col>.

owner_brief: The safe you stole must've been seriously packed, because the heat is stuck on you. You need something big to get these guys off your back. <Col: StageText>Plant a bomb</Col> here, and <Col: StageText>protect it</Col> till it goes off.
dispatch_brief: The gang is trying to drop off the radar by causing a mass panic with a bombing. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>planting that bomb</Col>.

owner_brief: The local gangs are getting rich by selling off their stolen goods. Now we've discovered who's helping them. Go <Col: StageText>raid the location</Col> of the local fence.
dispatch_brief: We have a guy who moves the goods you acquire for us. The Praetorians are searching his place right now. <Col: StageText>Stop the raid</Col>.

owner_brief: There was no stolen property there. Could have been tipped off, though... <Col: StageText>Pick up</Col> the fence's <Col: StageText>cars</Col> to be impounded.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians found nothing. But they are heading to search the vehicles that belong to our fence. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>picking up the cars</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Get those cars</Col> back to the Praetorian lockup and we can begin a thorough search for evidence.
dispatch_brief: It will be bad for us if the Praetorians find any of our goods in the fence's vehicles. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering this car</Col> to their vehicle lockup.

owner_brief: A package showed up outside the fence's house. <Col: StageText>Pick up the package</Col> and bring it in. We suspect it's dirty money.
dispatch_brief: Some dickhead just left his payment outside our fence's house. You can't leave it there - or be caught with it. So you better <Col: StageText>stop the Praetorians</Col> from <Col: StageText>recovering that money</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Deliver that package</Col> back to the Praetorian lockup. It will connect the fence to the car and the stolen goods.
dispatch_brief: That money will link our fence to some of our robberies and get him put away for years. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering the money</Col> to their evidence lockup.

owner_brief: Looks like the fence keeps info on who he works with. We found out where it's stashed, and need you to <Col: StageText>recover it and keep it</Col> away from any criminals.
dispatch_brief: Looks like the fence stashed the info on who he works with. We've found out where it's been stashed and need to <Col: StageText>recover it and keep it</Col> away from any Enforcers.

owner_brief: The Tigers have collected a lot of dirt on a dealer of stolen goods. Now we're ready to take her down. Go <Col: StageText>raid the shop</Col> this fence deals out of.
dispatch_brief: Evita has been selling on the goods you stole for us. Now she may get busted by the Prentiss Tigers. <Col: StageText>Stop their raid</Col> on her shop.

owner_brief: She looks clean, but we know she ain't. While you're in the area, <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>the fence's <Col: StageText>cars</Col> and we can search them for stolen goods.
dispatch_brief: Evita already emptied her shop of our stolen goods, but now the Tigers are going to search her car. They could find evidence of our whole operation. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>picking up her cars</Col>.

owner_brief: Rock on! The Tigers are taking this Criminal fence out of action. <Col: StageText>Deliver those cars</Col> back to our lockup, and we'll strip them for evidence.
dispatch_brief: Evita definitely has some of our stolen goods in those cars. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering the cars </Col>to their vehicle lockup and searching it for evidence.

owner_brief: Ha ha! Someone slipped up and left a packet of money for the fence. <Col: StageText>Pick up the package</Col> and bring it in. That's prime evidence.
dispatch_brief: One of Evita's customers has left his payments for her with a note that mentions us by name. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>recovering that money</Col>.

owner_brief: It's a home run! <Col: StageText>Deliver that package </Col>back to the Tiger lockup. It should link the fence to a whole folder full of unsolved crimes.
dispatch_brief: If the Prentiss Tigers link us to Evita and the stolen goods, we're all going down. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the money</Col> to their evidence lockup.

owner_brief: Looks like the fence keeps info on who she works with. We found out where it's stashed, and need you to <Col: StageText>recover it and keep it</Col> away from any criminals.
dispatch_brief: Evita has been fencing under a different name so Enforcers can't tie the note to her, but they did find out about her stashed book of contacts. <Col: StageText>Recover it and keep it</Col> away from any Enforcers.

owner_brief: The San Paro Standard published a story about stores selling DIY plastic surgery kits. Investigate the claims. <Col: StageText>Hack </Col>into this <Col: StageText>network point </Col>and look for abnormal transactions by local stores.
dispatch_brief: Some "brave and courageous" reporters at the Standard ran a story about 'under the counter' DIY plastic surgery kits. Stop the Enforcers <Col: StageText>hacking </Col>into our network to investigate the claims.

owner_brief: Two stores show unusual 'under the counter trading' activity. One of the owners has also been cruising a lot of internet surgery sites. <Col: StageText>Search </Col>these <Col: StageText>locations </Col>for any DIY surgery materials.
dispatch_brief: Enforcers have found information on some of our stores' illegal activities and are headed to search their storage units. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching </Col>the units.

owner_brief: Not the bust we hoped for - The owner's son wants to impress the ladies; hence the web traffic. But you did find stolen car parts. Confiscate the parts and <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at this <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers searched the storage units. Luckily our DIY surgery stuff ain't stashed there, but they've taken some stolen car parts and are going to <Col: StageText>drop them off </Col>at their lockup. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

owner_brief: The techs re-ran that network data you pulled and turned up a hospital orderly. He mentioned a deal with a local store. We have cause to <Col: StageText>raid these storerooms </Col>and look for any medical supplies.
dispatch_brief: Damnit! The Enforcers found out about the main stash of surgical materials. They're on their way to <col: StageText>raid these storerooms</col>. Do whatever you need to do to <Col: StageText>stop them</col>.

owner_brief: That's a hell of a thing: irradiated lipo fat and collagen powder. Wouldn't want that in my ass. This shop is definitely dealing. Pick up that contraband and <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Too late! The Enforcers raided the storerooms and confiscated our DIY surgery materials. They even took the Little Kiki 'My First Botox' kits! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>it to their lockup.

owner_brief: We just got a garbled emergency call - sounded like 'you should pray for the damn paramedics'. Caller was near you. <Col: StageText>Search the nearby ambulance </Col>for anything suspicious.
dispatch_brief: We just sent in a bomb threat to the hospital to act as a decoy. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this vehicle </Col>and discovering it's a hoax.

owner_brief: Nothing suspicious there, so relocate to where the call was made from and see if anyone is hanging around; <Col: StageText>search the payphone </Col>for intel.
dispatch_brief: 'Torians are scattered around the hospital looking for bombs and generally being distracted, but they could be onto us. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching the payphone </Col>we made the call from.

owner_brief: Nothing there either. Now it sounds more like the anonymous caller said 'pay' rather than 'pray'. <Col: StageText>Search these ATMs</Col> in case. I'll send the audio files off for analysis, or we'll be chasing this all day.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians are closing in on us by tracing the account I used to pay for the hoax phone calls. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this ATM </Col>and getting fingerprints off of it.

owner_brief: The audio analysis is back. The call was just from some graffiti nuts saying they would 'spray that San Paro relic' rather than 'pray for damn paramedics'. Just go and <Col: StageText>cover up their graffiti tag</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians have finally figured out there were no bombs. But in that time some of our guys had time to put up an awesome new tag. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up this new graffiti</Col>.

owner_brief: We just got a call from the hospital about a threat towards their ambulances. Maybe someone doesn't like the sirens. Get your fat ass over there and <Col: StageText>search their emergency vehicle </Col>for bombs.
dispatch_brief: We need some time to set up the weekly tag competition. My bomb threat to the hospital should keep the Tigers busy. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this ambulance </Col>and discovering it's all a hoax.

owner_brief: No bombs on the vehicle, but now we got a call about a suspicious <Col: StageText>payphone. </Col>Ya know what that is, right? It's a phone for poor people. Hangs on the wall. Go <Col: StageText>search </Col>it.
dispatch_brief: I've made another hoax call to the Prentiss Tigers, this time about a payphone. Watch them run down there like eager little schoolgirls. Ha ha! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching the payphone </Col>and spoiling the fun.

owner_brief: The payphone looks clean, as in 'nothing suspicious'. But go wash your hands and rinse away the poverty. On your way, <Col: StageText>search the local ATM </Col>as this is near to where the phone card was purchased.
dispatch_brief: The weekly tag-off graffiti-fest is under way, and we want to keep the Prentiss Tigers as far away as possible. I've told them there is a skimmer on this cash machine. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching the ATM</Col>.

owner_brief: All that running around for nothing; just like gym class. It looks like these calls were a decoy to distract the Tigers while hooligans tagged the area. <Col: StageText>Cover up their graffiti</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Looks like the Tigers finally figured out that it was us making all the hoax calls. But we had enough time to hold the graffiti competition. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up the winner's graffiti</Col>.

owner_brief: The CEO of Colby is on a rare visit to San Paro to meet Justin Teng, our leader. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these known Criminal <Col: StageText>hideouts </Col>along the route he'll take. We don't want any Criminal interference.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians have some sorta big cheese visiting them. Just because we have a few hangouts along his route, they're <Col: StageText>raiding our places</Col>. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

owner_brief: Good work, soldier; the last thing we want is a dead billionaire on the streets during our watch. <Col: StageText>Spray over that tag in the area </Col>too, to show we have this location locked down tight.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians don't want their visiting corporate buddies to see any graffiti on the way to their meeting. <Col: StageText>Go stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up our tags</Col>.

owner_brief: A couple of heavily armed thugs have just been spotted on our CCTV. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>their last known <Col: StageText>locations </Col>so I can tell Mr. Teng that the visit can go ahead.
dispatch_brief: Some of our hideouts were raided and our tags covered up by Praetorians - just so they can show off in front of some visiting CEO. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding any more of our hideouts</Col>.

owner_brief: The route has been altered. Our guest, Mr. Colby Jr., will be coming into the City via another route. <Col: StageText>Cover up the tag in that area </Col>too.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians now want to <Col: StageText>cover up more tags </Col>as they'd spoil a big business photo opp. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>. At least we're honest about our activities - unlike these corporate criminals.

owner_brief: The Criminals have found us, despite our detailed preparation. <Col: StageText>Control this area</Col>, give Colby Jr. a show of how we like to use his company's weaponry.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians don't want anything to spoil their high-powered corporate pow-wow. <Col: StageText>Takeover the area</Col> of their meeting to show them how we take care of business.

owner_brief: Pansy-ass elected officials think we're not producing results fast enough. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these <Col: StageText>drug dens </Col>and show them that Prentiss Tigers have claws.
dispatch_brief: The Pubescent Tigers are trying to drum up political support by smashing up some of our hangouts. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding our places</Col>.

owner_brief: That's an A+ result, duderino; maybe those fat-ass do-nothing politicians will leave us alone a while. <Col: StageText>Spray over the tag in the area</Col> too. Let's make a clean sweep.
dispatch_brief: The Prentiss Tigers who raided our hangouts obviously haven't finished annoying us yet. <Col: StageText>Go stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up our tags</Col> - they are a symbol of our resistance.

owner_brief: The press will love this. <Col: StageText>Raid </Col>these other <Col: StageText>drug dens</Col>, while I tell Byeong Lee - he wants to order a press conference. Wipe the blood off your clothes for the cameras... On second thought - don't.
dispatch_brief: Our hideouts have been raided and our tags covered up, just so the Tigers can show off for some politicians. Enough already! <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>any more of our <Col: StageText>hideouts</Col>.

owner_brief: The press conference will be in your area in 15 minutes. Remember, shiny buildings make for good pro-Tigers photos. <Col: StageText>Cover up the tag in this area </Col>too.
dispatch_brief: The Prentiss Tigers want to hold a pro-Enforcer press conference. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>covering up </Col>more of our <Col: StageText>tags</Col>. They say our graffiti spoils their photo opportunity.

owner_brief: A gang of camera-shy Criminals are trying to scare away the press. Losing this photo opportunity could cost us big time - <Col: StageText>control the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Let's give the gathered media a real photo opportunity, and something to write about! <Col: StageText>Takeover the area</Col> to show everyone who really runs things around here.

owner_brief: We've got some C.S.I.s in the field in need of supplies; they're busy scraping a prosecutor's brain matter off the walls. <Col: StageText>Pick up the supplies </Col>and get them to the C.S.I. team.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians are trying to dig up some information on a hit our crew did. Go <Col: StageText>prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the supplies </Col>needed for their investigation.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Deliver the supplies </Col>to the C.S.I.s and see if they've found anything. Reports say the murder victim was working on a case against Green Planet; conveniently for them, he's now G-King fodder.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians are <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>forensic supplies to some C.S.I.s they've got in the field investigating our hit. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>the C.S.I.s have collected so far, then <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at the lockup; they'll pass it on to the lab.
dispatch_brief: Evidence on our crew that carried out the hit has been found by the Praetorians and they're bringing it to their lockup facility. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering that evidence</Col>.

owner_brief: The G-Kings have noticed our investigation; they've sent out some of their gang-bangers to contaminate other crime scenes related to the shooting. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>controlling these areas</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The evidence those Praetorians picked up might lead them to some other crimes we've committed. <Col: StageText>Control and defend these areas </Col>so we can remove any evidence.

owner_brief: A mobster's bloated body turned up just an hour ago. We've got some C.S.I.s in to check it out; they need special gear. <Col: StageText>Pick up the supplies </Col>and get it out to them.
dispatch_brief: The Tigers are trying to investigate a mobster corpse we'd prefer stay dead and buried. Go <Col: StageText>prevent them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the materials </Col>needed for their investigation.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Deliver the supplies </Col>to the C.S.I.s and <Col: StageText>pick up the evidence </Col>they've collected so far. The corpse had info about some 'Sal Murino' guy, I hear. Maybe it's the reason he got whacked?
dispatch_brief: The Tigers are <Col: StageText>delivering </Col>forensic supplies to C.S.I.s investigating the dead mobster we put in the ground. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>the C.S.I.s have gathered and <Col: StageText>deliver </Col>it to our <Col: StageText>lockup </Col>. I don't think we'll find this Sal guy, though; he disappeared from Witness Protection years ago.
dispatch_brief: The Tigers found evidence on that mobster's corpse that links him to the crew we got to whack him. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering that evidence</Col> to their lockup facility.

owner_brief: A few of the Mob seem to think we capped the dead mobster. They're heading out to rough up some of our people. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>controlling these areas.</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The evidence those Tigers picked up might lead them to some other crimes we've committed. <Col: StageText>Control and defend these areas </Col>so we can remove any evidence.

owner_brief: We just got an unusual call from an undercover cop - Officer Albert Finn of the SPPD. He's hidden a PDA with details about an urgent mission. Go <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>PDA</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers are using this area as a dead drop for their undercover operatives. Make the area too dangerous for them and <Col: StageText>interrupt any pick-ups </Col>they attempt.

owner_brief: Officer Finn is working deep, deep, deep undercover. Several SPPD officers just turned up to a drug deal with his gang. He left us information on who: <Col: StageText>search these vehicles </Col>for his <Col: StageText>files</col>.
dispatch_brief: Looks like we've got a mole - that PDA was dropped off by somebody in our gang. Now the Enforcers are after files incriminating some of our members. <Col: StageText>Stop the pick-up</Col>.

owner_brief: Officer Finn left another set of <Col: StageText>files </Col>for <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>at these addresses, <Col: StageText>raid them</Col>. With corrupt SPPD officers involved, Officer Finn knows its only us he can trust. Don't let him down.
dispatch_brief: That undercover mole has been busy - the Enforcers are picking up more information on our gang operations. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>recovering those files</Col>.

owner_brief: You've got all the files. <Col: StageText>Deliver everything </Col>here and we'll start moving in on the suspects. Watch out for reprisals - corrupt cops have a lotta dangerous friends.
dispatch_brief: If we ever want to find out who our Enforcer mole is, we need to recover that information. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the files </Col>to their lockup.

owner_brief: As a clincher, Officer Finn wants us to <Col: StageText>retrieve and hold </Col>onto his <Col: StageText>laptop </Col>until we download all the corroborating data.
dispatch_brief: This is getting out of hand - now the mole has taken a laptop detailing our latest plans. <Col: StageText>Retrieve and hold </Col>onto our <Col: StageText>laptop </Col>until we can delete all the data.

owner_brief: We've got some Pit Vipers in the lockup and we need you to <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>their street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>and <Col: StageText>deliver them </Col>to the impound lot.
dispatch_brief: <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>our street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>and <Col: StageText>impounding </Col>them. At this point in the season, we'd miss the Silver Street leg of the race for sure.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>those Pit Viper <Col: StageText>cars </Col>at the <Col: StageText>impound lot</Col>. If we don't keep bustin' their shit, they'll just keep riding all over us.
dispatch_brief: Enforcers picked up three of our street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>- <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>dropping </Col>them back to their <Col: StageText>impound </Col>lot. I still can't see what their beef is with street racing through pedestrian areas!

owner_brief: Nice work, we just picked up more racers - White Blades this time. They hate the Pit Vipers, so we're gonna throw 'em in a cell together. <Col: StageText>Pick up their cars </Col>.
dispatch_brief: Enforcers are trying to impound more of our street racing cars. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cars</Col>. Don't they know we're three wins away from a championship placing?

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>those White Blade cars <Col: StageText>here </Col>and we'll lock them up. You should hear the ruckus down in the cell block. Blades hate Vipers, that's a fact.
dispatch_brief: We need those street racing <Col: StageText>cars </Col>- <Col: StageText>stop </Col>the Enforcers <Col: StageText>dropping them off </Col>at their <Col: StageText>impound </Col>lot. We're already behind after forfeiting the Silver Street leg of the race.

owner_brief: Looks like our luck could be back in - we just located a garbage truck containing evidence from some White Blades that got busted.<Col:StageText> Grab that truck</Col> and <Col:StageText>Protect it</Col> until we can get a confession.
dispatch_brief: There's a garbage truck out there containing proof we've been using illegal mods.  If the other racers find out we'll be out for sure.  <Col:StageText> Capture and Hold the Dumpster</Col> while the crusher does its work.

owner_brief: Thieves robbed a bank that was under Praetorian protection. They were seen escaping into this neighborhood. <Col: StageText>Check this building </Col>for any sign of the perpetrators.
dispatch_brief: Some of our guys robbed a bank and are hiding out in this neighborhood. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching </Col>the area.

owner_brief: That address wasn't occupied, but a neighbor reported armed men abandoning gear and equipment before entering another building. <Col: StageText>Raid the building </Col>before their backup arrives.
dispatch_brief: The 'Forcers have found the location of our bank robbery squad. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>their location.

owner_brief: The thieves fled, but we found personal effects that will help us track them down. <Col: StageText>Pick up the evidence </Col>and <Col: StageText>drop it off </Col>at our <Col: StageText>lockup.</Col>
dispatch_brief: Thankfully our robbery team made a quick exit, but the Praetorians now have some abandoned tools and clothing that may lead to their capture. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>to their <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.

owner_brief: The Criminals are in the open and on the run. They've dropped <Col: StageText>cash </Col>whilst being pursued. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the cash </Col>before they do!
dispatch_brief: That escape didn't go quite as planned. Our team were forced to drop some bags of cash while being pursued. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the cash </Col>before the Praetorians can use it to build a case.

owner_brief: We got some partial prints and an address where the robbers may be hiding out. <Col: StageText>Raid the building.</Col>
dispatch_brief: Damn! The Prentiss killjoys have found where we concealed the bank robbers. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding </Col>their refuge.

owner_brief: All the cash dropped from the robbery has been picked up. <Col: StageText>Get the cash</Col> to the local Prentiss Tiger  lockup, and don't let the Criminals get in your way!
An SPPD Narcotics officer has gone missing while deep undercover. We agreed to look into it. <Col: StageText>Hack this antenna </Col>so we can track the officer's cell phone.
dispatch_brief: An undercover cop infiltrated our operation - find him before the SPPD uses Enforcers to extract him. <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>hacking this aerial </Col>in order to track the informant's cell phone.

owner_brief: We're not getting any signal from that Narcotics officer's phone. It may just be out of range. <Col: StageText>Bug this satellite dish </Col>to search a larger range.
dispatch_brief: They're still trying to extract that undercover SPPD cop. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>rigging this satellite </Col>to boost the range of their cell phone scan. They're using it to search for him.

owner_brief: Still no signal, so either the cell phone is turned off or he left the city. We do have the last known position of the cell signal, though. <Col: StageText>Raid this building </Col>- and keep a sharp eye out for any signs of trouble.
dispatch_brief: We've dealt with the cop who infiltrated our operation, but now Enforcers are searching for him at his last phoned-in location. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding this smuggling office</Col>.

owner_brief: The officer wasn't there, but something obviously went down. Looks like a drug deal gone bad... Whoa, hold on: the officer's cell was just turned on, and we've located it. <Col: StageText>Raid this location</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Enforcers are still searching for information on the SPPD cop we 'took care of'. Don't let them search this building until we've cleaned it up. <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>raiding this storehouse</Col>.

owner_brief: The evidence suggests that the Narcotics officer was brought here and killed. He must've turned his phone on while they were moving him. <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>any <Col: StageText>clues </Col>you've found to our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Enforcers have found evidence for what we did to that SPPD officer. Wasn't hard - the crime scene wasn't too pretty... <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the evidence </Col>to their lockup.

owner_brief: We've received enough evidence that a warrant is out on the criminals involved.  <Col:StageText> Take them down</Col>, dead or alive.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers recovered evidence on the killing of that SPPD officer, we're going to go down for life. <Col: StageText>Kill the Assholes </Col>before they can testify.

owner_brief: The SPPD just handed us a cold case from a few years back. <Col: StageText>Take </Col>these <Col: StageText>files </Col>and go over them at the crime scene. The victim was an SPPD cop, back in the time of Commissioner Thirly.
dispatch_brief: A buddy of ours got away with murder a long time ago, but it looks like the Enforcers are re-opening his cold case. <Col: StageText>Prevent Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>any new <Col: StageText>evidence</Col>.

owner_brief: New witnesses say they saw the cop in two other locations the night he was killed. <Col: StageText>Go to the crime scenes</Col>, and update the case files with any new evidence you find.
dispatch_brief: Where the gun was stashed and the body turned up were key locations in that cold homicide case. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>investigating </Col>those <Col: StageText>crime scenes</Col>. Unless someone's built a mall on them...

owner_brief: Great work - looks like that SPPD cop was murdered by a colleague. Tsk tsk... <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>the <Col: StageText>updated files </Col>back <Col: StageText>to the lockup </Col>for analysis.
dispatch_brief: The 'Forcers have just finished going over those crime scenes and updated a bunch of cold case files. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>dropping off </Col>the <Col: StageText>files </Col>for analysis.

owner_brief: That cop-killing cop has hired help to screw up the last of the evidence. <Col: StageText>Secure these crime scenes</Col>: if we can uncover solid DNA evidence, we’ll be able run it against the SPPD databases to find our killer.
dispatch_brief: Our homicidal friend is leaving town, but he told us where the 'Forcers will head next. <Col: StageText>Go to these crime scenes</Col> and contaminate them. Ruin the evidence so it will be inadmissable in court.

owner_brief: A Blood Rose is blogging about a new shipment of grenades. They were sent as components to stay undetected, but we found them. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the grenade body assemblies </Col>from this <Col: StageText>vehicle</Col>.
dispatch_brief: We had a shipment of grenades sent as separate components but the Enforcers still found them! <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>the 'Forcers from <Col: StageText>retrieving the box </Col>of grenade casings we hid in this <Col: StageText>vehicle</Col>.

owner_brief: The rest of the grenade shipment had been stashed around the city. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the charges and fuses that are stored in these <Col: StageText>boxes</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers have found our box of grenade casings. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up this box </Col>of fuses.

owner_brief: The last part of the grenade shipment contains the pins and pull rings. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>case </Col>here. Without them, the gangs may as well be throwing stones.
dispatch_brief: Enforcers have confiscated all but one of the components from our grenade shipment. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>retrieving the case </Col>full of pins and pull rings.

owner_brief: Great Work! <Col: StageText>Drop off </Col>those deadly <Col: StageText>components </Col>at our <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>, so they can be melted down into promotional CSA paperclips or something.
dispatch_brief: All our grenade components have been taken by the Enforcers. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the shipment </Col>to their lockup. Make the 'Forcers go - boom!

owner_brief: The Criminals obviously still need their frag fix. They want to steal replacement grenades from our supplies. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col>. Don't they know: never touch another dude's pineapple.
dispatch_brief: There are easier ways to get hold of grenades - like stealing them from the Enforcers! <Col: StageText>Force your way in </Col>to their supply depot. We need those grenades.

owner_brief: They've raided one of our supply depots! <Col:StageText>Retreive the weapons</Col> and drop them off at the secure location.
dispatch_brief: There's more than just grenades here! Take the weapons back to the <Col:StageText>drop-off</Col>. You'll be handsomely rewarded.

owner_brief: Lonny Dorengo came over here from the Concession and has been cutting himself into the action - hitting gangs as much as cops and 'Forcers. He's planning a meeting. <Col: StageText>Plant bugs in the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Lonny Dorengo came here from the Concession, and has been hitting up gangs and 'Forcers alike. We're gonna deal with him, but need privacy for the hit - <Col: StageText>stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>bugging these payphones</Col>.

owner_brief: Lonny Dorengo ain't particularly stable - he'll pull shit on anyone with gold, drugs or cash. Needless to say he ain't got many friends left. <Col: StageText>Plant a bug on his window</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Lonny Dorengo ain't stable - he'll pull shit on anyone with gold, drugs or cash. You can imagine how much we hate his guts. <Col: StageText>Stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>bugging this shop front </Col>so we can kill him discreetly.

owner_brief: Just in case Lonny gives his "You see Derren's face on this dollar? I wipe my ass on it" speech, <Col: StageText>plant a bug on this ATM</Col>. That should cover enough of the area to overhear anything talked about.
dispatch_brief: This is always the problem when you want to do a hit - no fucking privacy. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>bugging this ATM</Col>. Lonny Dorengo has to die today!

owner_brief: We've got a listening post set up. <Col: StageText>Head there and wait </Col>until we hear something we can use. Lonny's on the way, driving that big-ass car of his.
dispatch_brief: Lonny thinks we've built up our loot again after his last raid - he's on the way to claim it. We gotta kill him now, so <Col: StageText>stop Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>getting to their bug-listening post</Col>.

owner_brief: Lonny's pretty excited - a gang he fucked over last week has rebuilt their stash. <Col: StageText>Pick up the stash </Col>before he gets to it. Meanwhile, we're gonna bust every last one of these mofos for racketeering.
dispatch_brief: Lonny Dorengo is dead! Unfortunately, the 'Forcer surveillance squad heard the whole thing, and are coming to bust us. No love there, then. <Col: StageText>Recover the bag of loot </Col>we used to bait Dorengo.

owner_brief: That loot was bait to get Lonny out in the open. His own gang and the target gang both turned on him. <Col: StageText>Deliver </Col>the bag of <Col: StageText>loot </Col>to the <Col: StageText>lockup</Col>. Make sure Criminals don't get hold of the bag.
dispatch_brief: <Col: StageText>Deliver the bag of loot </Col>back to our hideout and make sure the Enforcers don't get hold of it. With Lonny out of the way, we ought to be able to build up a much larger stash.

owner_brief: Our CSA license allows us to carry out private security work, and a few of our clients need cash to be picked up and delivered. <Col: StageText>Collect the armored truck </Col>we'll use to transport the money.
dispatch_brief: Several business owners want to avoid paying us protection by using Enforcers to transport their daily takings. Bad idea. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the security truck </Col>they use.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>cash </Col>and keep it safe. Like a lot of places in San Paro, this neighborhood has some bad elements, so make sure you keep the money out of Criminal hands.
dispatch_brief: I hear those business owners will be transporting a lot of money - in this neighborhood, that could easily go missing. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cash</Col>.

owner_brief: Nice work! That's why we've always had satisfied clients. Now <Col: StageText>drop off the money </Col>to its destination.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers are going to drop off those bags of cash. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the money </Col>and completing their contract.

owner_brief: Welcome to the crazy world of private security: one of our clients just dropped their money en route to the pick-up. Klutz. <Col: StageText>Search this area </Col>and see if you can <Col: StageText>recover </Col>the <Col: StageText>bag of cash</Col>.
dispatch_brief: Lucky us! The Enforcers were doing one last pick-up, but a klutz shop assistant dropped the money on the way. <Col: StageText>Stop the Enforcers </Col>from <Col: StageText>searching this area </Col>for the missing money.

owner_brief: Good job - all the <Col: StageText>cash </Col>has been picked up and accounted for. <Col: StageText>Drop it off </Col>here, and don't let any Criminals get hold of it.
dispatch_brief: The Enforcers are going to drop off that <Col: StageText>bag of cash</Col>. Stop them. <Col: StageText>Deliver it </Col>back to our hideout instead. Meanwhile, we'll double the protection payments for those shop owners!

owner_brief: We know that the gangs collect their account sheets at this time of year. <Col: StageText>Break into </Col>their accountant's <Col: StageText>vehicle </Col>and get that vital <Col: StageText>information</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians have targeted our accountant to see where we're earning our money. Make sure they don't get hold of the <Col: StageText>account sheets </Col>he has in his car.

owner_brief: The gangs use drop-off points to relay their financial information. If we <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>their <Col: StageText>account sheets </Col>first, we'll get a valuable overview of their organization.
dispatch_brief: 'Torians are collecting financial intel on our organization. <Col: StageText>Stop 'em </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>the <Col: StageText>account sheets</Col>. They'll only be jealous of our wealth, anyway.

owner_brief: The final set of <Col: StageText>account sheets </Col>was left for <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>here. Don't even bother trying to read 'em, though: you'll fall asleep on the job.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians have gathered most of the financial files they need to make a case against us. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>the last of the <Col: StageText>accounts</Col>.

owner_brief: Get those <Col: StageText>account sheets </Col>and <Col: StageText>deliver </Col>them back here now. We'll be able to examine every element of the gang's business.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians have a wealth of evidence against us now. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>bringing </Col>the <Col: StageText>account sheets </Col>back to their <Col: StageText>lockup</col>.

owner_brief: Another successful Praetorian case, and the gangs don't like it! You'd think they'd be proud of their 'figures'. They'll attempt to save face by controlling this corner. Go <Col: StageText>secure the area</Col>.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians won't be able to use that financial evidence against us if they can't present it in person. Prevent that - <Col: StageText>control this corner</Col> to scare off any possible jurors; extreme prejudice encouraged.

owner_brief: A Tiger's deep undercover in a local gang. He's gonna leave details of their armaments for us, hiding them in normal looking packages. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the first set of <Col: StageText>intel files </Col>from this <Col: StageText>vehicle</Col>.
dispatch_brief: I suspect the Tigers are being sold info on our armaments. I made a dummy <Col: StageText>document </Col> and left it in this vehicle. See if its location gets leaked. If anyone tries to collect it, <Col: StageText>stop them</Col> .

owner_brief: The next set of <Col: StageText>intel files </Col>was left for <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>at this address. Nothing concrete in these reports yet.
dispatch_brief: We need to find out who is leaking our plans to the Prentiss Tigers. In the meantime, <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>more <Col: StageText>files </Col>on us.

owner_brief: The last set of <Col: StageText>intel files </Col>from our inside guy was left for <Col: StageText>pick up </Col>at this address. Hopefully they'll give us an idea of the gang's offensive capabilities.
dispatch_brief: We're closing in on our mole, but they're still evading us for now. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up </Col>the last of the <Col: StageText>files </Col>that have been leaked.

owner_brief: You've got all the <Col: StageText>intel files</Col>. <Col: StageText>Drop them off </Col>at this Tiger safe house.
dispatch_brief: We've plugged our leak - permanently - but the Tigers already have a lot of information. Stop them from getting the intel <Col: StageText>files </Col>back to their <Col: StageText>lockup</col>.

owner_brief: The gang knew they had a mole in their midst and killed him. The mole's last tip pointed us here. <Col: StageText>Control this area</Col>; we'll be there soon with a team to sweep the area.
dispatch_brief: I put a tracker in those files, so we can trace who's been stealing our armament documents. It definitely was the Tigers, and now they're searching for files. <Col: StageText>Control this area</Col> and neuter those pussies.

owner_brief: The San Paro Standard has been hammering us over the way we do things. Praetorian PR wants you to <Col: StageText>raid these gang premises</Col> and showcase our firm-but-fair community policing.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians are desperately trying to kiss ass with the San Paro Standard by <Col: StageText>raiding our hangouts</Col>. Go <Col: StageText>stop them</Col>!

owner_brief: A bust like this will make us look great in the press. <Col: StageText>Take the evidence</Col> from the bust back to the lockup for some 'impromptu' photo opportunities.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians are calling the refuse they recovered  'evidence of positive policing'. WTF? Time to hijack their big press conference. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering</Col> that trash back to their lockup.

owner_brief: Our press release hits and journalists're gonna swarm this place - they'll see it's a shithole! Cover up any tags... Gotta show 'em this place is 100% under our control.
dispatch_brief: 'Torians like to pretend to the press they've wiped us out for a while, by nuking our graffiti. But we pop back like roaches. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>covering our tags</Col>.

owner_brief: Mikko Wong at the San Paro Standard has been saying we only sign up as Enforcers to get laid. <Col: StageText>Raid these gang hideouts </Col>and show her the Tigers can go all the way.
dispatch_brief: The Prentiss Tigers are trying to be tough guys for the cameras. They're <Col: StageText>raiding our hangouts</Col>. Go <Col: StageText>stop them</Col>.

owner_brief: A bust like this will make us look great. <Col: StageText>Drop off the evidence</Col> from the raid at the lockup. We'll get started on writing the press release.
dispatch_brief: The Tigers grabbed our stuff so they could say their stupid raid was a success to the local press. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>delivering</Col> it back to their lockup. I got a birthday card from my mom in there.

owner_brief: That successful raid is generating some press heat. <Col: StageText>Cover up these tags</Col> to show we're in control of the neighborhood. Hell yeah, we're SO all gettin' laid tonight!
dispatch_brief: Now the Tigers are pretending to be all goody-goody for the camera by wiping off our graffiti. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>covering our tags</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Investigate</Col> this property. Its alarm is linked to a Praetorian security network, and has been going off.
dispatch_brief: We needed to cause a distraction, so I've hacked into the 'Torian security network and I'm setting off random burgular alarms. Help me out. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians</Col> from <Col: StageText>investigating</Col> the alarms.

owner_brief: We've just had another alarm go off. <Col: StageText>Investigate</Col> and try to apprehend the burglar in situ.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians' security network is wide open. I'm setting off more alarms as a distraction. The 'Forcers are running around like headless chickens! <Col: StageText>Don't let them investigate</Col> further.

owner_brief: Another alarm is going off... this can't be a coincidence. <Col: StageText>Force your way inside</Col> and check the place out. Something's going on.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians may be on to the fact I've hacked their network. Buy me time to log out. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>investigating</Col> my set up.

owner_brief: Someone is hacking into the Praetorian system and setting off random alarms, probably to distract us from other crimes. <Col: StageText>Sabotage the antenna</Col> they're using for their uplink.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians have discovered my hacking uplink. <Col: StageText>Stop them</Col> from <Col: StageText>disabling the antenna</Col> I use to disrupt their systems.

owner_brief: Good work, you've disconnected them from our security system. We've got a fix on the laptop they used to hack the Praetorian server. <Col: StageText>Retrieve the hard drive</Col> from it.
dispatch_brief: They've got a fix on my security alarm hack and tracked down the PC I was using. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>taking the hard drive</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Deliver that hard drive </Col>to the lockup. Once it's analyzed, we should be able to find out who did this and how.  Make sure the criminals don't get their hands on it.
dispatch_brief: The laptop I used to hack the security systems was confiscated by the Praetorians. <Col: StageText>Recover the drive</Col> and return it before they drop it off.

owner_brief: LaRocha arrested some G-Kings earlier today and found a list of car bomb targets. This is definitely worth further investigation. Check out this vehicle for any explosives, if a bomb is present <Col: StageText>defuse</Col> it.
dispatch_brief: Goddamn Praetorians! LaRocha just stumbled upon our list of city officials targeted for car-bombing. <Col: StageText>Guard the bombs </Col>and make sure no one stops them from going boooom!

owner_brief: The list LaRocha found must be legit. <Col: StageText>Defuse </Col>the <Col: StageText>bombs </Col>from these other vehicles on the target list.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians are trying to defuse the car bombs we've planted around the city. <Col: StageText>Guard the bombs </Col>and make sure no one stops them from going off.

owner_brief: The group behind those car bombs is still looking to cause a major distruption. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>planting more car bombs</Col>.
One of the bombers dropped the PDA they've been using to program the bombs. <Col: StageText>Retrieve and hold onto that PDA.</Col>
dispatch_brief: One of our bombers dropped the PDA we've been using to program the bombs. <Col: StageText>Retrieve and hold onto that PDA.</Col>

owner_brief: It looks like the gangs have a vendetta against pro-Derren journalists, and want to cause a news blackout. <Col: StageText>Defuse</Col> any car bombs on this vehicle -  it's top of a hit list we found.
dispatch_brief: We've selected several Enforcer-friendly journalists for a bit of 'censorship' - car bomb style. <Col: StageText>Guard this car </Col>to make sure no one discovers the bomb we've planted in it.

owner_brief: This list must be the real deal. <Col: StageText>Defuse </Col>the <Col: StageText>bombs </Col>from these other vehicles on the hit list we found. They all belong to journalists.
dispatch_brief: The Tigers must have found out about our car bombing plan. <Col: StageText>Guard the bombs </Col>to make sure they go off.

owner_brief: Someone is still looking to drop a cherry bomb down the crapper that is San Paro. Protect the journalists. <Col: StageText>Stop </Col>whoever is behind this from <Col: StageText>planting more car bombs</Col>.
One of the bombers dropped the PDA they've been using to program the bombs. <Col: StageText>Retrieve and hold onto that PDA.</Col>
dispatch_brief: One of our bombers dropped the PDA we've been using to program the bombs. <Col: StageText>Retrieve and hold onto that PDA.</Col>

owner_brief: A Praetorian client needs some money transported. <Col: StageText>Pick up the vehicle </Col>they've supplied. Take care of it - you'll need to return it when the job's finished.
dispatch_brief: 'Torians are starting up a new cash delivery service for local businesses. We don't want them running it through our turf. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>getting their vehicle</Col>.

owner_brief: <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the first batch of <Col: StageText>money </Col>our client needs to have transported, and keep it safe.
dispatch_brief: The Praetorians will ruin our sources of easy money with their armed escorts. Disrupt their activities. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cash</Col>.

owner_brief: Now collect the second bag of money our client needs to have transported. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>cash </Col>and keep it safe.
dispatch_brief: It looks like the Praetorians have only sent a small team to protect all that money. This is our chance to do some damage to their reputation. <Col: StageText>Stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the cash</Col>.

owner_brief: This is the last collection. <Col: StageText>Pick up</Col> the <Col: StageText>money </Col>and keep it safe. This is how the Praetorians will take back the city: one job at a time.
dispatch_brief: We don't want all of San Paro's money to be so well guarded. Show the local businesses that hiring armed protection won't do them any good. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>collecting the cash </Col>successfully.

owner_brief: Good work out there. Now <Col: StageText>drop off the cash</Col> and <Col: StageText>return the vehicle</Col> to its owners.
dispatch_brief: Praetorians're spending a lotta time collecting money from local businesses - convenient. <Col: StageText>Stop 'em </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the cash</Col> - we could shut down their whole op in this area.

owner_brief: Great work completing the job, even with those Criminals giving you trouble. <Col: StageText>Stop them robbing </Col>our client's business!
The Criminals are looking for our client. <Col: StageText>Hold and Protect</Col> his property! Praetorians see that the job's done, all the way to the end.
dispatch_brief: <Col: StageText>Capture and Hold</Col> the area. Those toy soldier Praetorians aren't half as tough as they wish they were.

owner_brief: Local business owners are tired of paying protection money to gangs. They've hired the Tigers to protect their weekly cash collection. <Col: StageText>Pick up the vehicle </Col>they've supplied. Don't trash it, dude - it's on loan.
dispatch_brief: Some businesses think we charge too much to 'protect' them from all the nasty gangs around here. They've hired the Tigers to make their weekly cash collection. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from picking up their vehicle.

owner_brief: Head on over to the first collection point. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>money </Col>and keep it safe. And don't scratch the paint job on that loaner too badly.
dispatch_brief: Those business owners are really asking for trouble, calling in those Prentiss brats to protect their cash. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the money</Col>.

owner_brief: No one messes with the Tigers. The next cash drop can be found here. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>money </Col>and keep it safe.
dispatch_brief: If anybody should be getting protection money from the local businesses, it's us. <Col: StageText>Stop the Prentiss Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the money </Col>they're supposed to be transporting safely.

owner_brief: All right! This is the final collection. <Col: StageText>Pick up</Col> the <Col: StageText>money</Col> and keep it safe. With your help, local businesses now see they no longer need to pay gangs for protection.
dispatch_brief: I bet the local businesses are paying the Tigers more for protection than we were charging to leave them alone. <Col: StageText>Stop the Tigers </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the money</Col> and successfully transporting it.

owner_brief: Nice work. Now <Col: StageText>drop off the cash </Col>and <Col: StageText>return the vehicle </Col>we were loaned. Hope you didn't scratch it.
dispatch_brief: You gotta hand it to the Prentiss Tigers. They're good delivery boys. But <Col: StageText>stop them </Col>from <Col: StageText>delivering the money </Col>or other businesses might stop paying us protection money too.

owner_brief: Looks like the gangs have turned up to enforce penalties for non-payment. <Col: StageText>Take them out </Col>and <Col: StageText>stop them from robbing </Col>our clients' businesses!
The Criminals are looking for our the local business owners. <Col: StageText>Hold the area</Col> Tigers are in it to win it, all the way to the end of the game.
dispatch_brief: <Col: StageText>Take over the area</Col> Those local business-men have it comin' to them - serve it up, nice and hot.

owner_brief: Two Praetorian colleagues were killed in the line of duty. Forensics are at the scene right now. <Col: StageText>Collect </Col>the <Col: StageText>evidence </Col>they've uncovered so far.
dispatch_brief: 'Torians planted drugs on us and then - surprise, surprise - found them. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up the drugs </Col>they planted.

owner_brief: Our fallen colleagues were chasing down a gang of criminals. <Col: StageText>Pick up </Col>the <Col: StageText>money </Col>the cowardly gang dropped as they fled; it could be vital evidence.
dispatch_brief: The cheating Enforcers have gone through several of our homes and taken any savings they can find, saying it's blood money. <Col: StageText>Stop the Praetorians </Col>from <Col: StageText>picking up our cash</Col>.
